FIELDS.NAME: Thread & Thimble Fabrics
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Jessica M. Thompson, Manager, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: jessica@threadandthimble.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Thread & Thimble Fabrics, we specialize in providing a wide range of fabrics, sewing supplies, and related notions to our customers. Our store is designed to create a welcoming atmosphere for sewers of all skill levels, offering everything from high-quality cottons and specialty fabrics to essential tools and notions. In addition to our retail offerings, we also host regular sewing classes and workshops, allowing customers to learn new skills and engage with the community. We prioritize safety and compliance, ensuring that our store meets all local regulations and that all employees are trained in safety protocols. Our experienced staff is dedicated to helping customers find the right materials for their projects and providing expert advice on sewing techniques. We maintain accurate inventory records and regularly assess our stock to ensure we have the most popular items available. With a commitment to quality and customer service, Thread & Thimble Fabrics strives to be the go-to destination for sewing enthusiasts in our area.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a small incident occurred in our storage area due to an electrical issue, causing damage to some fabric inventory. The estimated loss amount was $1,500. The incident has been resolved, and we immediately implemented additional safety measures to prevent future occurrences. Status: Closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class: II, Grade: B, Label: Locking Safe with Steel Construction
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and alarm system monitoring with additional on-site employee supervision during operating hours.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – We carry workers' compensation insurance as required for our employees. This ensures compliance with legal obligations and supports a safe workplace environment.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – We do not own or operate any other business; our focus is solely on Thread & Thimble Fabrics.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – We do not have any other insurance policies with this company at the moment. The only policy we have is "T&TF-2023-001."
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – We are not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we exclusively retail fabrics and sewing supplies.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – We do not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is solely on retailing fabrics and sewing supplies. This allows us to maintain a safe and manageable operating environment.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – There have been no foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens during the past five years. The business has maintained a stable financial status.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – We do not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or hazardous chemicals as our operations are focused on retailing fabrics and sewing supplies, ensuring compliance with safety regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Our operations do not involve any catastrophe exposure, as we primarily focus on retailing fabrics and sewing supplies, ensuring that all safety measures and compliance standards are in place.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize safety and compliance in our hiring practices and operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are no uncorrected fire code violations at Thread & Thimble Fabrics, and we ensure that our facility complies with all applicable safety regulations.
